description: A few thin red strings lie on the yellow surface in front of both hands. The left hand pins the left strand near the junction while the right hand repeatedly lifts and crosses the right strand over and around the center, then pulls it down to tighten, alternating and aligning the strands to braid and partially unbraid the red string; contact shifts between a left-hand object when the left hand holds a strand and a right-hand object when the right hand pulls and loops another, with brief two-hand object moments when both pinch near the braid.
